Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the PBS obituary wording “on the island of Faro, Sweden” (a diacritic-less rendering of Fårö, Sweden) as referring to Faro, Portugal, conflating the Swedish island Fårö with the Portuguese city Faro and thus proposing the wrong death location.
